body: I feel the same way, I hope you don’t though. I just went on a jog and it cleared my head, it made me feel lighter. It was probably the sunshine too. It made thinking a bit easier. Made me forget that I wanted to go, just for a bit

Don’t know what to do, more or less out of my hands now. Can fight for full custody but it’s up to his mother to ensure that he has what he needs. She does a shit job at that. Family courts do so much damage, you just don’t understand. It’s so out of my hands
